now.title: Luke Cage S1#12
now.text: Turk Barrett is a Harlem hustler whom Luke keeps shaking down for information.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A hustler Luke keeps shaking down for information.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The man who keeps shaking Turk down for information.

proposed.text: Luke tracks down Turk Barrett, whose tip-off led to Pop's death, crushes him inside a dumpster and makes him give up Diamondback's warehouse.

changes.evidence: In Luke Cage S1#12 (Soliloquy of Chaos) Luke confronts Turk on the street over informing Tone about Chico (which led to Pop's death), throws him into a dumpster and crushes it until Turk reveals Diamondback's warehouse. The current text is a generic summary and calls Turk a Harlem hustler, though he is a Hell's Kitchen crook (Misty tells him to go back to Hell's Kitchen in S1#2).

now.title: Luke Cage S1#13
now.text: When Candace's guilt drives her to Misty Knight, Mariah has her killed.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Pays Candace to frame Luke, then has her killed.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A waitress Mariah pays to frame Luke, then has killed.

proposed.text: While Mariah is held for Cottonmouth's murder, Shades kills Candace, the witness against her, and Mariah walks free.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Pays Candace to frame Luke. Walks free when Candace is killed.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A waitress Mariah pays to frame Luke, whose murder sets her free.

changes.evidence: In S1#13 (You Know My Steez) Misty arrests Mariah mid-interview; Shades, acting on his own, uses Misty's dropped phone to lure Candace out and kills her, so Mariah is released. Nothing shows Mariah ordering the killing, so 'Mariah has her killed' gives the act to the wrong person; Candace going to Misty is S1#12.

now.title: Luke Cage S1#13
now.text: Shades helps Mariah Dillard cover up her murder of Cottonmouth, and the two become lovers and partners in crime.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Mariah's lover and partner in crime, who helps cover up her murder of Cottonmouth.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Shades's lover and partner in crime. He helps her cover up Cottonmouth's murder.

proposed.text: Shades kills Candace Miller, the witness against Mariah, so she walks free. When Harlem's Paradise reopens, the two share a kiss.

changes.evidence: The current text repeats the Cottonmouth cover-up from S1#7 (stage 0). In S1#13 Shades kills Candace with Misty's phone, Mariah is released for lack of the witness, and at the reopening of Harlem's Paradise Mariah shares a kiss with Shades (fandom episode page, scene list).

now.title: Luke Cage S2#7
now.text: Tilda Johnson treats Luke's concussion at her herbal shop while he hunts Bushmaster, and he pulls her and her mother Mariah Dillard out of a burning building.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Mariah's daughter, who treats Luke and whom he saves from a fire.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The man Tilda treats, who saves her from a fire.

proposed.text: Luke pulls Tilda and her mother Mariah Dillard out of the burning house where Bushmaster leaves them.

changes.evidence: The concussion treatment is S2#4 (I Get Physical), already stage 0. In S2#7 (On and On) Bushmaster leaves Mariah and Tilda in the burning brownstone and Luke rescues them.
